beats_top.query: cornell student budget by scenario low income student costs beyond tuition
beats_top.why: The top result gives net price by income band and loan-payment projections, including implausible negative payments for low-income students, with no monthly living budget or Cornell/Ithaca cost lines. Our page answers in the first paragraph with a per-month figure for each of four situations, dated official sources and the arithmetic shown.
